sections.text_helper: Section 26.2 "RNG main features" in chapter 26 (True random number generator (RNG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 773.
sections.section_content:
• The RNG delivers 32-bit true random numbers, produced by an analog entropy source
conditioned by an NIST SP800-90B approved conditioning stage.
• It can be used as the entropy source to construct a non-deterministic random bit
generator (NDRBG).
• In the default configuration, it produces four 32-bit random samples every 412 AHB
clock cycles if fAHB < fthreshold (256 RNG clock cycles otherwise).
• Embeds startup and NIST SP800-90B approved continuous health tests (repetition
count and adaptive proportion tests), associated with specific error management.
• Can be disabled to reduce power consumption, or enabled with an automatic low
power mode (default configuration).
• Has an AMBA® AHB slave peripheral, accessible through 32-bit word single accesses
only (else an AHB bus error is generated, and the write accesses are ignored).
